title: That is because everyone and their mother now drive a ride share car and you can actually catch a cab. No one is on the corner hailing a cab anymore..
summary: That is because everyone and their mother now drive a ride share car and you can actually catch a cab. No one is on the corner hailing a cab anymore... ...still plenty of NYC cab drivers who I know though have no idea where they are going and the cars are still in rough shape
author: Greg McVerry
